nodes.summary: Layer-cake formula for the first moment on `(0, a]`: the integral of `y` over `(0, a]` equals the integral of the right tail minus the endpoint correction.

nodes.summary: Layer-cake formula for the truncated second moment, in terms of the upper tail `tailGe`. The term `x ^ 2 * tailGt μ x` removes the contribution from points with `|y| > x`, which lie outside the closed truncation interval.
nodes.title: Layer-cake formula for the truncated second moment

Strict upper tail of a measure

nodes.summary: For a probability measure `μ` on `ℝ` with regularly varying combined tail of index `-α`, `0 < α < 1`, and tail balance `p`, the first-moment tail integral satisfies `(∫ y in Ioc 0 (c * x), y ∂μ) / (x * combinedTail μ x) → p * α * c ^ (1 - α) / (1 - α)`.
nodes.title: Corrected regularly-varying tail integral

nodes.summary: The corrected truncated-second-moment asymptotic: for a probability measure on `ℝ` with regularly varying combined tail of index `-α`, `0 < α < 2`, the ratio `(∫ y in Icc (-x) x, y ^ 2 ∂μ) / (x ^ 2 * combinedTail μ x)` tends to `α / (2 - α)`.
nodes.title: Truncated second moment asymptotic for regularly varying tails

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
